column3: the father said: (opening of the passage; no English for the clause before it)
column4: ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞನೆಂಬ ಗರ್ವದಿಂದಲೂ, ವಿನಯರಹಿತವಾದ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳಿಂದಲೂ ವರ್ತಿಸಿದಾಗ (when he behaved with the pride of being all-knowing and with conduct lacking humility)
column5: The clause describing Śvetaketu's all-knowing arrogance and lack of humility before the father's address is not translated.
